date.as_written: munirandhai samudraiśca, yute nepālavatsare | bhādra ca sitapakṣetu, dvitīyāyāṃ ravaudine

notes: The chronogram 'muni-randhra-samudra' (muni = 7, randhra = 9, samudra = 4) by the principle of aṅkānāṃ vāmato gatiḥ yields NS 497 (~1377 CE). The catalogue gives 'Nepāla Samvat 794(!)', reading the chronogram without reversal (or correcting to NS 794 = 1674 CE).
